phz76hj9.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to smaller spaces with the GloBrite 65cm Mini Christmas Tree. It features 60 integrated multicolour LEDs with 12 selectable lighting modes, allowing you to customise the festive atmosphere. The sack-style base adds a traditional finishing touch, while the reusable design makes this mini tree a convenient decoration for Christmas displays year after year. 65CM MINI CHRISTMAS TREE: Compact artificial tree measuring approximately 65cm tall, ideal for tables, mantelpieces, shelves and smaller festive spaces. 60 INTEGRATED LED LIGHTS: Features 60 built-in multicolour LEDs to create a bright decorative glow throughout the Christmas season. 12 LIGHTING MODES: Choose from 12 selectable lighting effects to customise the appearance and atmosphere of your festive display. BATTERY OPERATED: Powered by 3 x AA batteries, allowing flexible placement without requiring access to a nearby mains socket. REALISTIC PE AND PVC FOLIAGE: Artificial evergreen branches combine polyethylene and PVC materials for a fuller natural-looking appearance. REUSABLE FESTIVE DECORATION: Designed for careful seasonal storage and reuse during future Christmas celebrations. Read the instructions before use Dreibach LTD, Unit 2 Capital Business Park, Manaor Way, WD6 1GW, United Kingdom.

5ev4jxr6.baseName: Walplus 150 LED String Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
5ev4jxr6.variantName: Walplus 150 LED String Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
5ev4jxr6.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 95 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

hx2cxprr.sourceDescription: Keep your real Christmas tree upright and hydrated throughout the festive season with this sturdy Christmas tree stand. Designed to support trees up to 7ft tall, it features a wide, stable base and four adjustable metal screw clamps to grip the trunk securely and help prevent wobbling or leaning. The integrated 2.1L water reservoir helps maintain tree freshness by providing a convenient supply of water. Made from durable polypropylene (PP), the lightweight, rust-proof stand is easy to clean and can be reused year after year.
